    "created_by_manager_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "visible_from_utc" TEXT NULL, "gif_attachment_json" TEXT NULL, "photo_attachment_json" TEXT NULL, "content_blocks_json" TEXT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT "ck_communication_message_title" CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_communication_message_manager_account_created_by_manager_id" FOREIGN KEY ("created_by_manager_id") REFERENCES "manager_account" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "shift_correction_request" (
    "id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_shift_correction_request" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "comment" TEXT NULL,
    "created_at_utc" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "day_of_month" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "employee_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "operation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ChangeTimes',
    "original_from_time" TEXT NULL,
    "original_to_time" TEXT NULL,
    "removal_snapshot_json" TEXT NULL,
    "requested_from_time" TEXT NULL,
    "requested_to_time" TEXT NULL,
    "reviewed_at_utc" TEXT NULL,
    "reviewed_by_manager_id" INTEGER NULL,
    "schedule_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "schedule_slot_id" INTEGER NULL,
    "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pending',
    CONSTRAINT "ck_shift_correction_dom" CHECK (day_of_month BETWEEN 1 AND 31),
    CONSTRAINT "ck_shift_correction_requested_order" CHECK (requested_from_time < requested_to_time),
    CONSTRAINT "ck_shift_correction_time_format" CHECK ((operation = 'RemoveShift' AND removal_snapshot_json IS NOT NULL AND schedule_slot_id IS NULL AND original_from_time IS NULL AND original_to_time IS NULL AND requested_from_time IS NULL AND requested_to_time IS NULL) OR (operation = 'ChangeTimes' AND removal_snapshot_json IS NULL AND ((original_from_time IS NULL AND original_to_time IS NULL) OR (original_from_time IS NOT NULL AND original_to_time IS NOT NULL AND schedule_slot_id > 0 AND schedule_slot_id IS NOT NULL AND original_from_time GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND original_from_time < '24:00' AND original_to_time GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND original_to_time < '24:00')) AND requested_from_time IS NOT NULL AND requested_to_time IS NOT NULL AND requested_from_time GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND requested_from_time < '24:00' AND requested_to_time GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND requested_to_time < '24:00')),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_shift_correction_request_employee_employee_id" FOREIGN KEY ("employee_id") REFERENCES "employee" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT "FK_shift_correction_request_manager_account_reviewed_by_manager_id" FOREIGN KEY ("reviewed_by_manager_id") REFERENCES "manager_account" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "FK_shift_correction_request_schedule_schedule_id" FOREIGN KEY ("schedule_id") REFERENCES "schedule" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)
